home.eyebrow: Digital SAT practice · English, Russian, Kazakh
home.h1: Find out which SAT skills are costing you points.
home.lede: Take a full practice test that adapts like the real Digital SAT. Get an estimated score range and a breakdown across all 8 skill areas, then practise the weak ones with explanations in Russian or Kazakh.
home.step1_body: 98 questions in two modules per section. Module 2 gets harder or easier depending on how you did in Module 1, the way the real test works.
home.step2_body: An estimated score range, and how you're doing in each of the 8 skill areas College Board reports on. Not just a percentage.
home.step3_body: Practice sets lean toward your weakest skills. The coach gives hints first and the full answer only when you're stuck, in Russian, Kazakh or English.
home.diff1_body: The test is in English. The explanations don't have to be. Ask in Russian or Kazakh; answer choices and key terms stay in English, so nothing is lost on test day.
home.diff2_body: Score estimates are shown as a range and labelled as estimates. Only College Board issues SAT scores, and we say so.
home.diff3_body: Tutors assign practice, see each student's weakest skills and send parents a short weekly update.
home.tutors_lede: Run your SAT group on AdaptivePrep and spend your time teaching, not marking.
home.tutors_point1: Give each student the adaptive practice test and assign follow-up practice.
home.tutors_point2: Ask the assistant for a class summary: each student's weakest skills, progress and latest estimate.
home.tutors_point3: Draft weekly parent updates in Russian or Kazakh from real results.
home.tutors_price: Tutor plan from $59 a month. Centres with several groups: write to us for a group price.
home.faq1_q: Is the estimated score an official SAT score?
home.faq1_a: No. Only College Board issues SAT scores. Our estimate comes from your practice test and is shown as a range. Use it to track progress, not as a promise.
home.faq2_q: What language is the test in?
home.faq2_a: English, like the real SAT. The interface, explanations and coach can be in Russian or Kazakh.
home.faq3_q: What does the free plan include?
home.faq3_a: New accounts start with a 7-day Pro trial. After that the free plan keeps a daily limit of practice questions and 15 coach messages a day. Pro raises both limits.
home.faq4_q: Is the AI coach safe to use?
home.faq4_a: It only covers the SAT and studying, gives hints before answers and has a daily message limit. It can still make mistakes, especially in maths, so check anything that looks wrong with a teacher.
home.final_body: You'll know your range and your three weakest skills within about three hours.
home.footer_tagline: Digital SAT practice for students in Kazakhstan.
home.footer_legal: SAT is a trademark registered by College Board, which is not affiliated with and does not endorse AdaptivePrep.
home.pricing_lede: Prices in tenge and US dollars. Cancel any time.
home.pricing_note_students: Every new account starts with a 7-day Pro trial.
home.pricing_note_tutors: Running a centre with several groups? Write to us for a group price.

intensive.seo_title: SAT Intensive · 8-week online SAT group · AdaptivePrep
intensive.seo_desc: An 8-week online Digital SAT group taught in Russian and Kazakh, with adaptive practice tests, skill reports and weekly updates for parents.
intensive.h1: SAT Intensive: 8 weeks with a tutor, before the March and May SAT.
intensive.lede: Two live lessons a week, a full adaptive practice test at the start, middle and end, and practice set for each student's weakest skills. Explanations in Russian or Kazakh. Parents get a short update every week.
intensive.inc1: 16 live online lessons covering both sections: Reading and Writing, and Math.
intensive.inc2: Three full adaptive practice tests (weeks 1, 4 and 8), each with an estimated score range and a breakdown by skill.
intensive.inc3: Homework on the platform, chosen for each student's weakest skills.
intensive.inc4: Pro access for the whole course: unlimited practice and the SAT coach.
intensive.inc5: A short weekly update for parents in Russian or Kazakh: what was covered, what was done, what to work on.
intensive.who1: Students in grades 9–12 preparing for the 6 March or 1 May 2027 SAT.
intensive.who2: English at roughly B1 or above. We check this on the first call.
intensive.who3: Students who will do 3–4 hours of homework a week. The lessons work only with practice in between.
intensive.step2: Free 20-minute call: we talk about goals and run a short diagnostic.
intensive.step3: Pay to reserve your place. We confirm by message.
intensive.teacher_body: {{name}} built AdaptivePrep and teaches exam preparation groups for students in Kazakhstan.
intensive.faq1_a: No. Nobody honest can. You'll see your estimated range at the start, middle and end, so you can judge progress yourself.
intensive.faq2_q: What if we change our minds?
intensive.faq2_a: If you change your mind before the first lesson, we refund the full amount.
intensive.faq3_q: What if a lesson is missed?
intensive.faq3_a: Lessons are recorded, and the homework for that week is on the platform.
intensive.faq4_q: Does the price include the SAT registration fee?
intensive.faq4_a: No. The SAT is booked and paid separately on College Board's website.
